objective: Run genuine two-stage Frozen-Qwen few-shot, DistilBERT and QLoRA validation with immutable checkpoints or prompt caches, exact score shards, fail-closed resume and automatically verified RunPod-to-local replication.

sealed_data_contract.selection_population: seen-aspect validation rows inside the exact outer training scope

frozen_qwen_few_shot.demonstration_selection: stable SHA-256 order from the exact outer train fold with no retrieval or result-guided selection
frozen_qwen_few_shot.stage_1_demonstrations: two positive and two negative examples
frozen_qwen_few_shot.stage_2_demonstrations: one negative one neutral and one positive example
frozen_qwen_few_shot.threshold_selection: seen-aspect validation only inside each exact training scope

evaluation.decoder: aspect threshold followed by top-one sentiment plus thresholded runner-up

checkpoint_and_resume.checkpoint_publish: write sibling temporary directory, hash every file, write manifest, atomic directory rename
checkpoint_and_resume.score_publish: write immutable CSV then manifest with contract, pair-identity and score hashes
checkpoint_and_resume.resume: accept only a complete artifact whose full contract and file hashes match; partial corrupt or changed state aborts
checkpoint_and_resume.configuration_change: a changed scientific contract creates a new content-addressed path; old artifacts may be controls but are not reused as exact
checkpoint_and_resume.interruption_boundary: only completed manifest-bearing units are reusable

replication.transport: OpenSSH/SCP using key authentication; no credential is stored in the repository
replication.publication: stage complete unit, verify byte counts and SHA-256, then atomically publish files and a local receipt

storage_budget.parallel_volume_policy: one independently audited 100 GiB volume and isolated output root per physical worker

basis.distilbert_candidate_checkpoints: 78 checkpoints at less than 0.28 GiB each
basis.qlora_candidate_checkpoints: 78 checkpoints at less than 0.03 GiB each
basis.validation_scores: 7,534,296 rows at a conservative 512 bytes per CSV row
basis.overhead_policy: remaining allowance covers manifests, logs, telemetry and filesystem rounding

formal_release_requirements: official test remains sealed and test-contract count equals zero
all checkpoint score-shard sync and restore tests pass
an interrupted transfer resumes without recomputation or overwrite
a corrupt checkpoint score shard and transfer are rejected
registered scope and job counts match this file
the three worker manifests form the exact dependency-closed union and the final merge audit reports 297 unique validation results
RunPod source commit equals the reviewed and pushed Git commit
startup GPU identity CUDA package and input-hash checks pass
declared RunPod volume quota leaves at least 20 GiB after conservative campaign growth
a fresh short startup telemetry sample has no OOM non-finite score collapse or slowdown
the local sync receiver is running before the formal executor starts
stop_conditions: official-test access or any test contract
hash-incompatible resume or local overwrite conflict
held-out validation labels used for parameter selection
third sentiment emitted for an aspect
automatic local replication is not healthy
